 Products

 Temperature and climate test chambers
 AR-Series 
 AR series: Temperature chambers and climate chambers from ESPEC 
The ESPEC AR series test chambers deliver reliable results for demanding test specifications with fast temperature changes of up to 18 K/min. With a wide temperature range from -75 °C to +180 °C and optional humidity control, the system simulates the required climate precisely and reliably. 
The test devices are suitable for electrically operated samples and test specimens that generate heat. The uniform temperature distribution guarantees consistent measurement results throughout the entire test run. For the special requirements of the automotive industry, the ESPEC AR series also has a control function for the sample temperature.
 Discover the special Features: 
LCD colour touch display with program function for easy operation incl. USB and Ethernet interface
Water tank and direct connection VE water
Cable port Ø 100 mm left & right, further optional
Product sensor and two potential-free switching contacts
movable version

 FAQs 
 Are the devices air or water cooled?
Up to 5 K / min rate of change, the appliances are equipped with an air-cooled cooling unit as standard, but water cooling is available as an option. From 5 K / min, the appliances are equipped with a water-cooled cooling unit as standard.
